name: @mailwoman/neural-weights-it-it

requires.$comment: Copy of the base card's requires block — same trained ship-config, same fail-closed contract via createScorer. This overlay shares the base model.onnx byte-for-byte, so the channels it was trained against are the base's; keep in lockstep with neural-weights-en-us/model-card.json on every base ship. Without this block the loader inferred the channels from the ONNX graph and resolved the evidence lexicons by legacy filename, which fed street_type by guess and left locality_surface OFF (v6 sought, v7 shipped); a consumer of the published tarball, which carried no lexicon at all, ran gazetteer, country and both evidence channels OFF against a model trained with them (#1668, #2115). Measured before shipping: locality_surface ON vs OFF, 0 of 49 board rows differ (DE 12, ES 25, IT 12).

anchor.$comment: span_mode 'shaped' is the 9.0.0 SHIP OBLIGATION (recipe header + ROAD_TO_V9 A2): the train painter keys postcodes as shape-detected spans, space-stripped upper ('SW1A 2AA' → 'SW1A2AA'); the default alnum-run scan can NEVER produce that key, so omitting this leaves GB/NL postcodes unanchored at serve — the mirror image of #1467. createScorer fails closed on a shaped-declaring card paired with an artifact whose keys the scan cannot reach.

$comment: Data-only overlay. Shares model.onnx + tokenizer.model with en-us via mailwoman.baseWeights.

it_artifacts.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R11 (2026-08-02). The Italian instance of the dependent-locality prior.

pair_index_it_bin.format: PIX1 placetype-pair index — a retrieval-augmented (quartiere, comune) dependent_locality prior, e.g. ("Trastevere", "Roma")
pair_index_it_bin.source: Who's On First admin hierarchy. No postal register carries the sub-city line for this country, so WOF is the source — the same call the US, DE and IN instances made.
pair_index_it_bin.$comment_pix2: PIX2 (schema 3, 2026-08-04): every record now carries the PARENT's ComponentTag alongside the child's — +1 byte per pair, pair COUNT unchanged. The recorded parent tag is the WOF parent ROW's placetype projected through PLACETYPE_PROJECTION, so a locality/localadmin parent reads `locality` and a borough parent reads `dependent_locality`. This artifact deliberately ships WITHOUT a `parentDelta`: no board has graded the parent side for this locale, and the D-rule's answer to an unmeasured locale is a per-locale check rather than a magnitude inherited from us/gb/nz/fr. Absent means the parent bias is OFF here, not zero.
pair_index_it_bin.delta_calibration: δ=10, transitionBeta=5 — inherited from GB per R5's uniform-deficit finding.
pair_index_it_bin.requires_leading_postcode_strip: INERT without the `it` entries in SEGMENT_PARENT_POSTCODE_SHAPES and LEADING_POSTCODE_COUNTRIES (neural/placetype-pair-prior.ts) — Italian addresses write the postcode first.
pair_index_it_bin.parent_alias_expansion: ENABLED. WOF stores `Rome` (its English preferred name) for a city Italians write `Roma`, carried as the `ita` preferred name. Aliases are drawn from names whose language is OFFICIAL for the country (codex isOfficialLanguage) plus English, and must be LATIN-SCRIPT — the model never sees other scripts.
pair_index_it_bin.not_committed: derived artifact, .gitignore'd — rebuilt via `mailwoman gazetteer pair-index --out neural-weights-it-it --country it --delta 10 --transition-beta 5 --borough-db <wof/admin-global-priority.db>`
